$comment: Specs that require a real Supabase — the ones the `e2e-authenticated` CI job runs.
Kept under version control so that losing coverage is a RED build, not a quieter one.
Discovery (scripts/lib/auth-specs.mjs) compares against this list on every run and
fails in both directions: a spec that stops being detected (renamed fixture, new
indirection, deletion) and a spec newly detected but not yet accepted here.
Adding an authenticated spec? Add its path below in the same commit.
$quarantine_comment: Specs that DESCRIBE A DASHBOARD THAT NO LONGER EXISTS. They were merged, the
cockpit was rebuilt (THI-327 Situation Hero, #217 / #236), and nothing objected
because they had never executed anywhere: CI skipped them for want of a Supabase.
Running them for the first time on 2026-07-26 is what surfaced this.
They are listed, printed on every run with their reason, and NOT silently skipped.
Follow-up: rewrite each against the current dashboard, then delete its entry here.

quarantine.e2e/dashboard-expenses.spec.ts: Same cause: getByRole('heading', /dépenses —/i) against a CardTitle <div>.
quarantine.e2e/dashboard-data-flow.spec.ts: Same heading-role cause, plus getByText(/^Factures /i) on a surface the cockpit rebuild replaced.

quarantine.e2e/dashboard-cockpit-bloc2.spec.ts: Asserts testid effort-financier-card — present in ZERO files under src/. Tests the 'Bloc 2 hero radar' that the Situation Hero superseded.
